summary: Snowboarder Bindu Sky Pomeroy, 44, of Vail (teacher at Vail Ski & Snowboard Academy) died after going off a jump in the East Vail Chutes out-of-bounds backcountry; ~11:30 a.m. call, no suspicious circumstances
location: East Vail Chutes, out of bounds of Vail ski area
notes: Vail Ski Patrol, Eagle County SO, coroner, Vail PD and dispatch collaborated; US Forest Service land; jump-fall coded other/fatality per the road-gap-jump convention (id 2396); distinct from the 2014-01-07 East Vail Chutes avalanche (id 2362)
